title: Pretrained vs random attribution at 1/5/20% budgets
notes: Random control uses the same MOMENT architecture and patch embedding with randomly initialized weights; pretrained loading is forbidden by a runtime guard.
Original stream: per-series z-score on valid observations then zero-pad; diff stream: per-series z-scored first difference on valid observations, same as E09.
One random initialization per data seed, shared by orig/diff/dual; logistic C=1.0 for all streams.
E16b adds 1/5/20% budgets using the same saved random/pretrained feature caches; no new extraction.
